We review the electoral and boundary arrangements of councils to make sure they are fair. Our reviews include at least two rounds of public consultation before we make recommendations for change. 

We are carrying out an electoral review of Wirral because it has been a long time since the last review.  

Visit our 'How reviews work' pages for more information on the review process

Latest Information

Making our recommendation into law

Parliamentary Scrutiny: Made Order

The Wirral (Electoral Changes) Order 2026 has completed its passage through Parliament and was made on 17 September 2026.

On 12 October 2026 a correction was issued to the Order, correcting an incorrect ward name in the Schedule.

Councillor numbers

The first stage of this electoral review is to determine the number of councillors who should represent the local authority in the future. The Commission has decided that the number of councillors in Wirral Council should be 66, the same as now.

Wirral Council submission on council size
View & Download

Effective date

The Borough of Wirral (Electoral Changes) Order 2003 was made on 31 July 2003

The new arrangements came into effect at the May 2004 elections.
